user.title: Phase Guard
user.description: For every phase pick the voltage sensor of the house input — a meter installed BEFORE the phase protection relay — and one or more indicators AFTER the relay. Phases without indicators are not monitored.

data_description.phase1_input: Voltage sensor of a meter upstream of the protection relay. It must lose power (go silent) during a real grid outage.
data_description.phase1_indicators: Voltage sensors after the relay, or any devices on this phase that become unavailable when they lose power. The phase counts as dead only when all of them are dead.
data_description.phase2_input: Voltage sensor of a meter upstream of the protection relay. It must lose power (go silent) during a real grid outage.
data_description.phase2_indicators: Voltage sensors after the relay, or any devices on this phase that become unavailable when they lose power. The phase counts as dead only when all of them are dead.
data_description.phase3_input: Voltage sensor of a meter upstream of the protection relay. It must lose power (go silent) during a real grid outage.
data_description.phase3_indicators: Voltage sensors after the relay, or any devices on this phase that become unavailable when they lose power. The phase counts as dead only when all of them are dead.
data_description.input_min_voltage: Input readings at or above this value mean the grid is present.
data_description.indicator_min_voltage: Applies only to voltage-sensor indicators. Other entities count as alive while they are available.
data_description.input_max_age: If the input sensor has not reported for longer than this, its data is treated as missing (the meter is probably unpowered).
data_description.debounce: How long a phase must stay dead before an event is registered. Short blips are ignored.

error.no_indicators: Select indicators for at least one phase.
